sqlGroup.select:
select a.id, a.`name`, a.address, a.province, a.city, a.phone, a.scale, a.website, a.company_business, a.parent_id, a.sales_revenue, a.sales_revenue_year, a.tax_number, a.legal_entity, a.staff_qty, a.land, a.customer_product, a.warehouse_qty, a.store_qty, a.stock_code, a.remark, a.erp_code, a.type, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.sales_lead_id, a.agent_account_id, d.name as agentAccName, c.name as salesLeadName, b.`name` as parentAccName, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName, us.`name` AS updateStaffName, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as created_time, date_format( a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as update_time, a.if_validated_dealer, date_format( a.dealer_date_dl, '%Y-%m-%d' ) as dealer_date_dl, a.verify_status, a.validation_note, a.area_code, ar.name as areaName, a.district, a.created_staff_id from jml_account a left join jml_account b on a.parent_id = b.id left join jml_staff cs on a.created_staff_id = cs.id left join jml_staff us ON a.update_staff_id = us.id left join jml_sales_lead c on a.sales_lead_id = c.id left join jml_account d on a.agent_account_id = d.id left join jml_area ar on a.area_code = ar.area_code
a.id=#{id}

select id, name from jml_account a
and type = "代理商"
